summary: Resolved the open gap and opened a second, distinct failure mode. Receipt 75c355f2a4634b5193fa97e4de987fe0 (exit 0, six events) repeats the no-snapshot pair with the same values as before (on: latest_index 0, servers 0, hasVote false while commit 11/lastApplied 11 were restored; off control: index 1, one voter) and adds the snapshot-present case: with the log's latest configuration at index 1227 holding two servers and the snapshot at index 1220 with configuration index 1, the restarted node came back at configuration index 1 with one server, so both declared comparisons are violated (witness event index 5, admission index 4). The interpretation for ef5ddbf78bd4456ea51537bd60a61a80-question-0 is now conclusion violated with defect_claim asserted, cited against receipt 75c355f2 with joint-history reasoning across the three receipts, and the registered gap is answered resolved=true. Separately, a probe of the second suspicion showed a sharp startup boundary: a committed backlog of 8002 entries (126 FSM batches) returned from NewRaft in 3 ms, while 8402 entries (132 batches) never returned within a bounded 15 s wait, consistent with restoreFromCommittedLogs pushing processLogs batches into the 128-capacity FSM queue before the FSM goroutine is started. That is recorded as a child question with its own two-case experiment submitted for a receipt, and a conditional interpretation asserting the defect claim pending that execution.
